topic: Fixing time zone naming and display
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on technical updates, specifically addressing an issue with the proper naming and propagation of time zones (e.g., Kyiv). It was noted that while the correct name was added to global time tables some time ago, it had not yet propagated to the current ClickHouse version.

Separately, issues regarding web responsiveness and display resolution were raised in relation to a dashboard view.
decisions: The team acknowledged the need to update the proper naming for Kyiv/time zones within ClickHouse.
action_items: Someone needs to correct the time zone name issue in ClickHouse.
Addressing web responsiveness and display resolution will be a future task.
